violation_type.title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §744.305(a)(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: It wasn't reported to Licensing that the operation sustained damage to the camp's primary space of the gym during the last major storm rendering it unsafe for use.
